items.title: Willie J. Humphrey and Willie E. Humphrey Interview, 1959-03-15
items.q: I used to play with Henry at King's Hall. I was playing violin at the time. I taught different bands. Ten-piece bands. I taught ten-piece bands.

ctx.x: Sam Dutre? Yeah, I was playing. He was playing by 19. Sam Dutre? Oh, yeah. I was in seventh grade together in school. Sam Dutre. Yeah, fine musician. Yeah, great. No, I didn't. I used to play with Henry at King's Hall. I was playing violin at the time. I taught different bands. Ten-piece bands. I taught ten-piece bands.
Did you play in parades very much? The brass band?
